第209章 战区调令宗师之战（第1页）
前线大规模作战的命令已经彻底停歇。
残余虫巢的清剿，交由本土防卫军与工程部队接手；地表被炸裂的矿区、塌陷的战壕、烧穿的补给线，也在一座座移动式重建工厂的轰鸣声中开始重新拼合。
远处，新的合金桩像一排排沉默的骨刺，沿着裂谷边缘钉入大地。
近处，自动铺设机正在把被熔流烧得焦黑的地面
见对方转头便开始搜寻起四周的线索，慢悠慢悠跟在对方身后，直到被警惕的瞪了几眼，并且将他推开，让他着去其他方向自己找，才无奈笑笑，转身往房间走去。
吃了饭，云浮笙算出那些尸骨所属何处，写好地址后交给顾天曜，就带着顾锦宁和顾秉锐出发去宫家老宅。
吴痕看去，从光尘画幕中，他看到了自己的城市，看到了热带馆，看到了躺在安全屋中昏睡的自己，还有被活死人给围困惴惴不安的父母。
待她离开唐荣从假山后走了出来，原本是担心辛安见了他会又会说话不客气，为避免尴尬才避开，倒让他看到了府中下人对她的态度。
先是走到姜时时面前，把抱了好久的烧鸡递给对方，动作很是恋恋不舍，语气又郑重严肃的拜托着替她暂时保管好。
“这个，我之前一直都没给你看过，既然已经说开了，就给你看看吧。”宋春暮回屋拿出一个本子来，放在宋雨霏面前。
大门口的那两只大狮子，就不是一般大户人家所能拥有的，足足有一丈多高。
“那我想你弟弟他应该能感受到，他后面会收敛的。”过了一会儿，宋洛回道。
她要是真收下了，龙尊心里必定会因为此事儿而对她产生一些不好的看法。
不得不说宋航那边对付起来，的确和宋厚德、郭铭等人大相径庭，宋航两次出手，倒是带动的他东奔西跑的。
昨天她被这赔钱货吓了一大跳，今天可是有妯娌在呢，真动起手来，她们俩还怕打不过这死丫头不成？
这座洞府，不仅极为宽敞奢华，各种设施极其完备，且灵气浓郁程度，堪比神鼎宗内山的神鼎山脚下的灵气程度。
就见到，这两张残破金纸，仿佛彼此间有着吸引力一般，在胡清云震撼的目光中竟是悄然融合，形成一张完整的金纸。

众人一起表态，齐齐以世子爷称呼姜烨，再不敢唤他表弟堂弟了。
只不过，现实世界的“实力”并不是那些影视剧里描写的那种唯一的而已。
然而，颜越在晋入炼气六层后，驱物术便已达到了这个火候，甚至犹胜七层。
沈墨霏脸上不易察觉的笑容一僵，突然站定，一巴掌狠狠的拍了下脑门。
南山派之人见颜越瞬杀一人，大惊失色，忙祭出手中红色阵旗，结起“绞杀大阵”。
灰珠突然震动，让摊主吓了一跳，同时也吸引到了边上修士的注意。
呵呵，还别说，莫明还就真的就是靠关系上去的，他靠谁的关系？当然是靠着颜凝雪和颜倾城了。
当他们回过得神来的时候，那幽主魔族的士兵已经冲到了一位神族的面前。
“要就要，不要就不要，现在不要，将来看着她成别人的新娘，你就只能后悔一辈子。”四四吼了他一声。
这样的举动可是把愣在一旁的车夫吓了一大跳，他在卢迦的背后连连惊呼着，生怕这么一折腾伤害了奥古斯都那尊贵的身子。

Chapter 209 The battle between the war zone command masters (page 1)
Orders for large-scale frontline operations have completely ceased.
The elimination of the remaining insect nests was handed over to the Home Defense Force and engineering troops; the blasted mining areas, collapsed trenches, and burned-out supply lines began to be reassembled amidst the roar of mobile reconstruction factories.
In the distance, new alloy piles were like rows of silent bone spurs, driven into the earth along the edge of the rift valley.
Nearby, an automatic laying machine is laying on the ground that has been scorched black by the melt flow.
When he saw the other party turning his head, he began to search for clues around him, and followed him slowly until he was glared at a few times warily, and pushed him away, asking him to look in other directions. Then he smiled helplessly, turned around and walked towards the room.
After eating, Yun Fusheng figured out where the bones belonged, wrote the address and gave it to Gu Tianyao, then took Gu Jinning and Gu Bingrui to the Gong family's old house.
Wu Hen looked around, and from the light and dust screen, he saw his city, saw the Tropical Pavilion, saw himself sleeping in the safe house, and his uneasy parents who were surrounded by the living dead.
When she left Tang Rong and walked out from behind the rockery, she was originally worried that Xin An would be rude again when she saw him, so she avoided it to avoid embarrassment. Instead, he saw the attitude of the servants in the mansion towards her.
First, he walked up to Jiang Shishi and handed the roasted chicken that he had held for a long time to her. His movements were very reluctant, and his tone was solemn and solemn, asking him to keep it for her for the time being.
"I've never shown this to you before. Now that I've said it, I'll show it to you." Song Chunmu returned to the room and took out a notebook and placed it in front of Song Yufei.
The two big lions at the gate are not something that ordinary wealthy families can have. They are more than one foot tall.
"Then I think your brother should be able to feel it, and he will restrain himself later." After a while, Song Luo replied.
If she really accepts it, Long Zun will definitely have some bad opinions about her because of this.
I have to say that the way Song Hang dealt with them was indeed very different from Song Houde, Guo Ming and others. Song Hang's two attacks actually drove him to run around.
Yesterday she was shocked by this money-losing guy, but today her sisters-in-law are here. If they really start a fight, are they afraid that they won't be able to defeat this damn girl?
This cave is not only extremely spacious and luxurious, but also has extremely complete facilities. Its aura is as rich as the aura at the foot of Shending Mountain, the inner mountain of Shending Sect.
They saw that these two pieces of broken gold paper, as if they were attracted to each other, quietly merged to form a complete gold paper under Hu Qingyun's shocked eyes.
Everyone expressed their stance together, calling Jiang Ye the prince, and no longer dared to call him cousin.
However, the "strength" in the real world is not the only one described in those movies and TV dramas.
However, after Yan Yue advanced to the sixth level of Qi Refining, his object-dispelling technique had already reached this level, even better than the seventh level.
The imperceptible smile on Shen Mofei's face froze, she suddenly stood still and slapped her forehead hard.
The people of the Nanshan Sect were horrified when they saw Yan Yue kill one person instantly. They quickly raised their red formation flags and formed a "Strangulation Formation".
The gray beads suddenly vibrated, startling the stall owner, and also attracted the attention of the monks nearby.
Haha, don’t mention it, Mo Minghuan really got up through connections. Whose connections did he rely on? Of course it was through Yan Ningxue and Yan Qingcheng.
When they came to their senses, the soldiers of the Youzhu Demon Clan had already rushed in front of a god.
"If you want it, don't do it. If you don't want it, don't do it now. If you watch her become someone else's bride in the future, you will regret it for the rest of your life." Four FourYelled at him.
This move startled the coachman who was standing aside. He kept screaming behind Lujia, for fear that such a move would hurt Augustus' noble body.
